Typography

You might say

All the text on this page runs together—separate the headings, body copy, and notes so the important stuff stands out.

Use text size and style to show what matters first·Typography separates headings, body text, and supporting information through size, line height, weight, and color. Define a small set of reusable text roles, then adapt them for different screens so readers can find the main point and follow the content.
Page Title · 22px bold
Section Title · 16px
Body · 14px: detail text with 1.6+ line height that stays easy to read.
Caption · 12px: timestamps, notes, secondary info.

You can say this to an AI Agent

“

Refine the settings typography with distinct page heading, section heading, body, and warning roles. Do not make warnings too small or light or bold the entire page. Verify a clear reading order and readable critical text on desktop and mobile.

Typography≠Heading

Typography is the full system of text roles and styles, including headings, body copy, and supporting text. A heading is only one text role that marks page or section hierarchy.

When to use it

  • Create clear levels for page, section, and item headings
    Page titleSection title
  • Keep long body text comfortable to read
    Body text needs a readable size and line height for long-form reading.
  • Make dates, notes, and other supporting details quieter
    Website redesign v2In progress
    Alex Chen updated 3 days ago · visible only to you
  • Emphasize a small number of truly important words
    This update fixed 12 issues; the payment flow changed the most, so test it carefully.

When NOT to use it

  • Use so many heading styles that the hierarchy disappears
    Heading 1Heading 2Heading 3Heading 4Heading 5
  • Set body text too small or too light to read comfortably
    This is an important instruction, but it uses 10px light-gray text that’s hard to read.
  • Bold a whole paragraph when only one point needs emphasis
    When every word is bold, nothing reads as the real priority.
  • Use spaces and line breaks to force alignment; use Space
    Name: Alex Chen
    Phone: 138 0000 0000    Full-width spaces break alignment when the font changes

# Typography

You might say
All the text on this page runs together—separate the headings, body copy, and notes so the important stuff stands out.

**Use text size and style to show what matters first**·Typography separates headings, body text, and supporting information through size, line height, weight, and color. Define a small set of reusable text roles, then adapt them for different screens so readers can find the main point and follow the content.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Refine the settings typography with distinct page heading, section heading, body, and warning roles. Do not make warnings too small or light or bold the entire page. Verify a clear reading order and readable critical text on desktop and mobile.

Typography**≠**Heading

[Typography](/vibe-hub/typography?lang=en) is the full system of text roles and styles, including headings, body copy, and supporting text. A heading is only one text role that marks page or section hierarchy.

### When to use it

- Create clear levels for page, section, and item headings

Page titleSection title
- Keep long body text comfortable to read

Body text needs a readable size and line height for long-form reading.
- Make dates, notes, and other supporting details quieter

Website redesign v2In progress
Alex Chen updated 3 days ago · visible only to you
- Emphasize a small number of truly important words

This update fixed 12 issues; the **payment flow** changed the most, so test it carefully.

### When NOT to use it

- Use so many heading styles that the hierarchy disappears

Heading 1Heading 2Heading 3Heading 4Heading 5
- Set body text too small or too light to read comfortably

This is an important instruction, but it uses 10px light-gray text that’s hard to read.
- Bold a whole paragraph when only one point needs emphasis

When every word is bold, nothing reads as the real priority.
- Use spaces and line breaks to force alignment; use [Space](/vibe-hub/space?lang=en)
